lead.headline: Equivariant iterated Eisenstein integrals for congruence subgroups of level 2
body: The modular properties of holomorphic Eisenstein series for $\mathrm{SL}_2(\mathbb{Z})$ and its congruence subgroups do not carry over to their primitives. Instead, the transformation of iterated Eisenstein integrals under congruence subgroups of level $N$ introduces inhomogeneous terms comprising (among others) cyclotomic multiple zeta values of level $N$.

We combine iterated Eisenstein integrals for the congruence subgroups of level $N=2$ of arbitrary iteration depth with their complex conjugates and (single-valued) level-2 cyclotomic multiple zeta values such that they define non-holomorphic modular forms. Our construction of these so-called equivariant iterated Eisenstein integrals for $Γ(2)$ and $Γ_0(2)$ proceeds at the level of generating series that take values in an infinite-dimensional (pro-unipotent) Lie group and closely follow Brown's analogous construction in the $\mathrm{SL}_2(\mathbb{Z})$ case.

features.headline: Second-order formulation of chiral fermions with a local boundary condition
body: Chiral fermions in $d$ dimensions arise naturally as boundary modes of a massive fermion in $d+1$ dimensions subject to a local boundary condition. When anomalies are absent, this construction can be used to define an intrinsically $d$-dimensional theory of chiral fermions.
However, defining the path integral using the first-order Dirac operator with this boundary condition is technically inconvenient, even in the continuum.

features.headline: From Integrability to Chaos in Tensionless AdS3 String Theory
body: We study quantum-gravitational corrections to the planar integrable structure of the symmetric product orbifold $\text{Sym}^N(\mathbb{T}^4)$ that is dual to tensionless string theory on AdS$_3\times$S$^3\times \mathbb{T}^4$. We consider the deformation that switches on R-R flux in the bulk, and analyze the associated level spacing statistics.
The leading non-planar corrections lift the planar degeneracies and produce signs of random-matrix behavior.

features.headline: Cardinal RG=GR: Phase-Space Cardinality and the Cosmological Constant and Hierarchy Problems
body: The effective field theory approach constructs the low-energy theory by integrating out fluctuations above an ultraviolet scale which raises the cosmological constant and hierarchy problems. We investigate an alternative prescription in which the quantum theory is restricted to a finite accessible region of phase space, characterized by a dimensionless cardinality $\mathcal N$, rather than by independently prescribed spacetime and momentum scales.

stories.headline: Dynamical Temperley-Lieb algebras from Quiver CFTs
body: The one-loop dilatation operator of a superconformal planar gauge theory can be written as a sum of local generators. The algebra these generators satisfy is a powerful organising principle for the spectrum.
For SU(2)-like bosonic subsectors we show that this algebra can be read off directly from Feynman diagrams, which we identify as a natural graphical language for it.

stories.headline: Upper Bounds on the Radion Mass in a Warped Extra Dimension
body: We study absolute upper bounds on the mass ratio $R_{11}=m_{r_1}/m_{h_1}$ between the radion ($r_1$) and graviton ($h_1$) lightest modes in five dimensional warped models. We consider warped models with an admissible singular behavior in the infrared: i.e.~models with power-like ($\sim \barφ^{2n}$) and with exponential ($\sim e^{2ν\barφ}$) bulk potentials, where $\barφ$ is the stabilizing bulk field.

stories.headline: Soft Factorisation of WQFT and the Spinning 4PM Magnusian
body: We derive the soft divergences of $\hat{N}=-i\log\hat{S}$ in the Worldline Quantum Field Theory (WQFT) formalism, focusing on poles due to single massive-massive (Coulomb) and massive-massless (tail) graviton exchanges. Our derivation is inspired by the Faddeev-Kulish procedure, switching the interaction picture to one with an infrared-finite $\hat{N}$-matrix.

stories.headline: UV Bounds on Inflationary Parity Violation
body: A question of fundamental interest is whether parity is violated on large scales in the Universe. This possibility has been motivated by recent analyses of the four-point matter correlation function.

It has also been suggested that detectable parity violation could be generated during inflation by the dynamical Chern-Simons operator, a leading effective field theory correction to general relativity.
stories.authors: Alexander Cassem and Mark P. Hertzberg

stories.headline: Equilibrium relativistic spin magnetohydrodynamics from chiral kinetic theory
body: We develop a microscopic and thermodynamically consistent framework for relativistic equilibrium spin magnetohydrodynamics of massless chiral fermions, directly from first-order chiral kinetic theory. Starting from the covariant Wigner function, we recast the chiral kinetic equation as a pure streaming equation on a magnetically shifted mass shell, incorporating both the magnetic-moment energy and the Berry-curvature phase-space measure.

stories.headline: Entropy Products and the Extremal Limit That Never Comes
body: Two regular black hole horizons need not have an entropy product fixed by the charges and couplings. In Einstein--Maxwell--scalar theory, we construct asymptotically flat branches with products above or below the squared extremal entropy.
Regularity selects their horizon scalar values, and different branches can share the charges, couplings, and asymptotic scalar.

stories.headline: Inhomogeneous Cutoff Regularization of Loops in Cosmological Correlators
body: We revisit the use of cutoff regularization in computing loop corrections to cosmological correlators. We argue that a cutoff corresponding to a fixed physical scale must be defined with respect to the local background geometry.
In the presence of superhorizon perturbations, this is naturally implemented within the separate universe picture, where different local patches are regulated at the same physical scale.

stories.headline: Stringy Corrections from Gravity: Predictions for BFSS and ABJM
body: Despite enormous progress in string theory, the leading stringy corrections to many holographic observables remain unknown. String/M-theory dualities nonetheless allow them to be determined from gravity alone.

From the winding modes of one-loop 11d supergravity on a circle, we derive the leading tree-level stringy terms in the type IIA effective action for the metric, dilaton, and Ramond--Ramond one-form, in closed form as a finite supertrace over Lorentz generators.

sections.name: Across the Border
sections.note: Papers whose primary category is not hep-th (mostly gr-qc), cross-listed into it

stories.headline: Notes on non-equilibrium thermodynamics of Robinson-Trautman spacetimes
body: Robinson-Trautman spacetimes are determined by a parabolic heat-type evolution equation of fourth order for a scalar field on future null infinity. This equation may be re-written as an energy balance for an asymptotically time-like observer.
In turn, it becomes a first law in the context of non-equilibrium thermodynamics if the non-linear memory is interpreted as heat.

stories.headline: Relativistic Kinetic Theory of Collisionless Particles with Variable Mass and Frame Transformations
body: In this work, we present the relativistic kinetic theory of a gas of collisionless point particles with non-constant mass, which can also be understood as being subject to a scalar force. Our results hold in an arbitrary conformal frame, and we explicitly derive how they transform between frames.

stories.headline: Pure integral formula of spinfoam amplitude and curvature corrections in effective theory
body: We develop a new analytic method for the semiclassical analysis of the Lorentzian EPRL spinfoam amplitude on a fixed triangulation. We derive a pure integral formula for the spinfoam amplitude that trades the discrete sum over internal spins for integrals over continuous variables.

briefs.headline: $C_T$ and $C_J$ of general scalar--fermion conformal field theories in $d=4-ε$
briefs.text: We compute $C_T$ and $C_J$, the coefficients of the stress-tensor and conserved-current two-point functions, to order $ε^3$ at any fixed point of the general renormalizable theory of scalars and fermions in $d=4-ε$.
briefs.authors: Shiroman Prakash and Shubham Kumar Sinha

briefs.headline: Classification of Chern-Simons Couplings and Deformed Pull-Backs on D-Branes
briefs.text: We establish a framework for classifying higher-derivative Ramond-Ramond (RR) couplings on Dp-branes, focusing on the complete scattering amplitude of a closed-string RR state, a gauge field, and two transverse scalars.

briefs.headline: All-Order Linearized Hydrodynamics of Charged Holographic Plasmas
briefs.text: We investigate linearized all-order transport in a finite-density holographic plasma described by five-dimensional Einstein-Maxwell-Chern-Simons theory.

briefs.headline: Exact Spherical Branes and Deformations: BMN, IKKT and $\mathcal{N}=2^\ast$
briefs.text: We present a unified analytic solution to the BPS equations of spherical Dp-branes for $1\leq p \leq 5$ and give the corresponding type II uplifts in closed form.

briefs.headline: Two Faces of Spacetime Density Matrices: Entanglement and Complexity
briefs.text: We establish a direct connection between entanglement and complexity through spacetime density matrices.

briefs.headline: Holographic Duals of $SL^{(q)}(2, \mathbb{R})$ Deformed CFTs
briefs.text: We study the holographic bulk dual of 2D CFTs evolved by $sl^{(q)}(2,R)$-deformed Hamiltonians.

briefs.headline: From Instantons to AdS Boundaries: Tracing the Geometric Path from Quantum Anomalies to Massive Gravity
briefs.text: This thesis studies how boundary data enter two gravitational observables: the Dirac index on gravitational instantons and conserved charges in three-dimensional New Massive Gravity.

briefs.headline: Entanglement entropy from fundamental strings
briefs.text: In previous work, we derived the local entropy capacity from off-shell string theory and combined it with the gravitational replica construction and flow-cut duality to normalize the entropy flow carried by physical fundamental strings.

briefs.headline: Twist and Shout: defect lines on the Rényi torus
briefs.text: We consider what the entanglement between two regions of a critical system can reveal about its symmetries, including non-invertible ones.

briefs.headline: Actionless Branes on Axion Wormholes
briefs.text: Can a Euclidean axion wormhole extend to infinity with every instanton still suppressed?

briefs.headline: Quiver-Invariant Triality between Brane Brick Models
briefs.text: We study quiver-invariant triality between 2d (0,2) supersymmetric gauge theories described by brane brick models associated with toric Calabi-Yau 4-folds.

briefs.headline: Twisting Spinning Particles with Superghost Backgrounds
briefs.text: We construct twists of spinning particles in the classical BV formalism by giving constant backgrounds to the bosonic ghosts of local worldline supersymmetry, in analogy with Costello and Li's twist of supergravity, which gives a nonzero background to the ghost of local spacetime supersymmetry.

briefs.headline: Black holes and 2-group symmetry from blackfolds in minimal supergravity
briefs.text: We investigate the black hole phase diagram of five-dimensional minimal supergravity using the blackfold approach and the framework of generalized symmetries.

briefs.headline: Worldsheet Effective Theory of Abelian-Higgs Cosmic Strings beyond Nambu--Goto
briefs.text: Cosmic strings can support long-lived excitations confined to their cores, opening channels for energy exchange with the transverse Goldstone modes that describe the string's motion.

briefs.headline: Numerical Implementation and Tests of the Quadratic Effective Action for Lorentzian Spinfoam Amplitudes
briefs.text: In the pure integral representation of Lorentzian EPRL spinfoam amplitudes, the integration over non-geometric variables in the large-spin limit defines an effective action for Regge geometries. (primary category gr-qc)

briefs.headline: Holographic Tessellations Tensor Networks $\{p,q\}$ from Entangled Quantum Tetrahedron in Loop Quantum Gravity
briefs.text: The relationship between spin network states in loop quantum gravity and bulk--boundary duality is further explored using the tessellated holographic tensor network.

briefs.headline: Pairwise fermionic mode correlations in electric and magnetic backgrounds: Landau-level structure and Schwinger production
briefs.text: We investigate mutual information and logarithmic negativity in fermionic Schwinger pair production in parallel electric and magnetic fields.

briefs.headline: Calabi-Yau linear models with abelian bundles
briefs.text: We introduce a construction of (0,2) gauged linear sigma models whose large radius phases realize Calabi-Yau sigma models with line bundles.

briefs.headline: Which black hole modes ring freely? Horizon regularity, the forced ringdown transient, and GW250114
briefs.text: The quasinormal modes (QNMs) of a black hole are defined by keeping only ingoing waves at the horizon. (primary category gr-qc)

briefs.headline: Full-Color Two-loop Four-point Form Factor in N=4 SYM with Global CK-duality
briefs.text: We determine the full-color two-loop four-point MHV form factor of the stress-tensor supermultiplet in N=4 super-Yang-Mills theory.

briefs.headline: A full-color four-point form factor
briefs.text: We determine the symbol and complete functions of the full-color two-loop four-point maximally helicity violating stress-tensor form factor in $\mathcal N=4$ super Yang-Mills theory, including $N^1$ double traces and $N^0$ single traces.

briefs.headline: Nonzero cubic Love numbers of Schwarzschild black holes
briefs.text: Static Love numbers of Schwarzschild black holes vanish at linear and quadratic order in General Relativity, while generic nonlinear tides remain less understood.

briefs.headline: Conformal manifolds of $\mathcal{N}=1$ orbifold theories - Part I: Marginal deformations and the one-loop spectrum
briefs.text: We consider orbifolds of 4d $\mathcal{N}=4$ super-Yang--Mills theory that preserve minimal supersymmetry and study their conformal manifolds, focusing on two families of Abelian orbifolds in the planar limit.

briefs.headline: Asymmetric Orbifolds and 4-dimensional $\mathcal N=4$ String Islands
briefs.text: We formulate heterotic and type II $\mathbb T^6/\mathbb Z_n$ asymmetric orbifolds preserving all 16 right-moving supersymmetries and leading to 4-dimensional islands without massless moduli other than the dilaton.

briefs.headline: Bianchi cosmologies with four-dimensional groups of motion in New General Relativity
briefs.text: We study the dynamics of the most general metric teleparallel spacetimes of Bianchi types II, III and IX, which admit a four-dimensional symmetry group, in the 1-parameter family of New General Relativity. (primary category gr-qc)
